requirements.text: Implement the smallest static contract/consumer guard proving current active code and prompts do not use qualitative Pullback v0.2 labels as standalone mechanical action, rebuy, recovery-failure or calibration authority while the policy remains GUIDANCE_ONLY. Do not invent numeric bands or triggers.
Descriptive pullback-label usage that preserves GUIDANCE_ONLY semantics passes the guard.
A future owner-authorized mechanically derived artifact is not rejected merely for using a label when all required reproducibility fields and authority are explicit.
Fixture mapping Moderate directly to REDUCE fails.
Fixture using a qualitative label alone as rebuy unlock, recovery-failure state or calibration HIT/MISS fails.
